test_title: PYST 5: SSC Stenographer - English (Held on: 15 Nov 2021 Shift 1 )
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If no substitution is required, select 'No substitution required'.**

Ever since my daughter started math tuition, she __is done quite better__ in the subject.
solution:
The correct answer is: **has been doing quite well**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Replace **"is done quite better" **with **"has been doing quite well"** to make the sentence correct.
 
• **Since **is mentioned in the given sentence, which means from a particular time in the past until a later time in the past or until now. So, '**done**
